label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-supplied param flows directly to host variable, then to fetchHttpByHostname making HTTP request. While isNonPublicAddress check exists, it only blocks loopback/site/local/link/any addresses - DNS rebinding attacks remain feasible (domain resolves to public IP during check, then redirects to internal resource). Also, some address types may evade detection. Resolved sink value: http://<user_input>/api - attacker controlled.

evidence.note: User param assigned to host, checked via resolveHost, then fetched via fetchHttpByHostname - SSRF path confirmed
